release_notes:
FocusDefend v1.8.7 Release — OEM Security Fix & Session Persistence:
• OEM Security Warning Elimination: Stripped MODE_BACKGROUND_ACTIVITY_START_ALLOWED and alarm-priority full screen intents that triggered Xiaomi MIUI/HyperOS and Samsung Knox high-risk operation alerts.
• Zero Auto-Close/Open Jitter: Replaced concurrent Home-kill and background activity collisions with instantaneous WindowManager card overlays, stopping restricted apps smoothly without continuous vibration loops.
• Persistent Unlock Sessions: Fixed premature session cancellation where pressing Back or switching apps wiped active credit sessions. Sessions now automatically pause and seamlessly resume with your remaining time preserved intact.
• Interactive In-Overlay Unlocking: Added direct credit unlock, 2-minute quiz challenges, quick pass requests, and Return to Home buttons directly on the overlay.
